subpages.text: About Us Capabilities Solutions Policies Policies & Disclosure Notices Certificates Our Quality Approach Personal Data Protection Media Innovation Careers Partnership Contact × About Us Capabilities Solutions Media Innovation Careers Partnership Contact Us Homepage > About Us PAVOTEK Where Ideas and Technology Meet PAVOTEK stands at the forefront of technological innovation, specializing in the design and production of top-tier electronic and embedded system solutions tailored to meet the most demanding customer requirements. As a leading technology powerhouse based in Türkiye, Pavotek has established itself as a key player in critical areas of national security. With a rich portfolio encompassing IP network communication devices, communication/control systems, power transmission/distribution units, unmanned avionics systems, and energy distribution systems, Pavotek has garnered a stellar reputation for delivering field-tested solutions that excel in both reliability and efficiency. Beyond its commitment to technological excellence, Pavotek places a strong emphasis on fostering innovation, evident in its unique products and key competencies that set it apart in the industry. The company's comprehensive approach, spanning from ruggedized military computers to advanced switches and routers in data centers, underscores its versatility and unwavering dedication to creating value for its customers. Who We Are At Pavotek , we design and manufacture top-notch electronic and embedded system solutions tailored to meet our customers' needs. These solutions encompass IP network communication devices, communication/control systems, power transmission/distribution units, unmanned avionic systems, and systems that enhance energy distribution efficiency.
